Draw chords CA and CB. The angle at C and the angle at O stand on the same minor arc AB.
The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference on that arc.
Therefore 2∠ACB = 128°, so ∠ACB = 128° ÷ 2.
Answer: ∠ACB = 64°. Check: 2(64°) = 128°.
